description:
Get full filing metadata including its content_object.

content_object lists every document in the filing with filename, doc_type,
description, sequence and whether a markdown version exists; read one with
get_document(cik, accession_number, filename). Cite beatandraise_base_url +
filename (the beatandraise.com viewer). The R*.htm files are
XBRL financial-table pages; list_filing_tables says which table each one is.

Args:
    accession_number: SEC accession number (e.g. "0001140361-26-006577")
name: get_filing_detail
title: Get Filing Detail
